scope: Representative full terminal logs for all four Windows native shards, macOS native Clippy/release, and two macOS canaries. No conclusion about uninspected latest-head jobs.
counting: 36 unique named FAILED Rust test lines across four Windows shards, deduplicating repeated test-log printouts. Link-failed targets, tests that never ran, and process-fatal interrupted tests are not added to this named-test count.

windows_test_failure_groups.status: small test-only candidate supplied; remote Windows validation pending
windows_test_failure_groups.cause: File::open(directory) fails with Windows OS code5. These tests must pass real writable directory handles to the unchanged durable ledger writer.

windows_test_failure_groups.status: small test-only candidate supplied; remote Windows validation pending
windows_test_failure_groups.cause: Sweep fixture passes D:\tmp\... path rather than Windows canonical form to WorkspaceBinding's unchanged strict canonicality check.

windows_test_failure_groups.status: candidate supplied; Windows six-test runtime gate pending
windows_test_failure_groups.cause: One named sandbox_feature_matches_linked_v8 failure plus process-fatal once-only allocator initialization; the fatal can prevent another test from reporting a result, so named count is not a full executed-test count.

windows_test_failure_groups.status: open: Windows secure storage backend absent
windows_test_failure_groups.cause: The first durable prompt registry open hits a deliberate not(unix) UnsafeStateDirectory branch. FinalUseAuthority has the same missing backend and is a subsequent necessary dependency, although these particular tests fail before reaching that constructor.

windows_test_failure_groups.status: open: Windows trusted SSHSIG verifier and immutable input transport absent
windows_test_failure_groups.cause: Immediate test failure is OS code3 launching hardcoded /usr/bin/ssh-keygen. Merely changing the test path cannot close the gate: G5 verifier explicitly rejects not(unix), and trust InheritedPipe refuses to construct on not(unix).

windows_test_failure_groups.status: open: production Windows directory persistence and full private-state contract require review
windows_test_failure_groups.cause: Production writes attempt File::open(parent)?.sync_all() and fail with Windows OS code5. This is separate from missing SSHSIG. Existing durable_windows.rs protects final file reparse/hard-link/identity checks, but it does not supply a complete owner-ACL and anchored-directory replacement contract. Do not treat a test-only directory opener as a complete security backend.

independent_build_failures.status: small wrapper candidate supplied; new-head native compilation pending
independent_build_failures.cause: Credentialed cache-only wrapper omits existing local MSVC C/C++ override; MinGW symbols reach MSVC Rust linker. Do not combine counts with runtime tests.

independent_build_failures.status: parent two-file source repair independently reviewed; new-head compile pending
independent_build_failures.cause: Clippy has the three plasticity_process_e2e helper expect sites plus two unsupported anyhow Context calls; release has the same two Context errors. Old blanket Context review assurance was incomplete and is superseded by the explicit signature receipt.

independent_build_failures.status: single command-scope toolchain pin candidate supplied; new-head smoke pending
independent_build_failures.cause: Cargo1.95 build dependencies are passed to rustc1.91 selected by registry package rust-toolchain.toml. Official-proxy local resolution proof retained; no V8 rebuild claimed.

independent_build_failures.status: macOS-only --jobs30 candidate supplied; new-head full artifact stage pending
independent_build_failures.cause: At stage materialization Java cannot create a native thread; log shows one Bazel server and prior800 concurrent actions. Resource-specific thread pool/OS limit is not identified. No multiple-server leak claim.

explicit_fail_closed_branches.result: OpenSSH SSHSIG verification requires Unix inherited descriptors

present: handle-based attributes, hard-link count, file index, volume serial
before/after handle and pathname snapshot checks
not_complete: durable.rs:374 verify_private_mode returns Ok on not(unix), so Unix owner/private-mode property is not demonstrated for a Windows DACL
durable.rs:404 same_file_identity fallback only compares is_dir, not native directory identity
directory persistence still uses ordinary File::open(parent)
existing_partial_windows_operator_suppor.qualification: These are source facts about coverage, not an exploit proof. No production security relaxation was proposed or applied.

proposed_minimum_backend_contract.status: Design requirements only; not implemented or qualified
storage_interface: open_or_create_private_directory with effective owner identity and protected private access policy
open/read/create regular leaf entries relative to an authenticated live directory handle, with no-follow and single-hard-link validation
stable file/directory identity snapshots and replacement detection while handles remain open
atomic same-directory state replacement plus real persistence/flush outcomes and indeterminate-durability classification
cross-process exclusive writer/claim lock and durable anti-rollback/replay state
windows_primitives_to_establish: effective Windows owner SID and DACL validation rather than a no-op private-mode branch; define allowed privileged principals explicitly
handle-anchored child lookup and replacement with reparse rejection for root/components/leaf, including junction and parent-swap races
native volume/file identity and hard-link count verified on exact opened handles
file flush plus publication/directory persistence protocol with documented guarantees and tested failure behavior
safe immutable verifier inputs or an equivalent reviewed in-process SSHSIG verifier preserving principal, namespace, policy and exact-byte bindings
proposed_minimum_backend_contract.not_an_implementation_plan_shortcut: Ordinary OpenOptions, path canonicalization alone, a trusted-looking executable name, skipping Windows tests or fabricating signature success do not establish this contract.

required_real_windows_acceptance: Existing positive and negative prompt delivery/pipeline/optimizer tests must run on native Windows without skips
Reject permissive/null/inherited-untrusted ACLs and wrong-owner roots/files; validate expected private-owner policy
Reject reparse points/junctions/symlinks, extra hard links and directory/file replacement races using actual Windows handles
Exercise concurrent processes and exact replay/claim uniqueness with the real lock implementation
Inject failures before/after file flush, atomic publication and directory persistence; after reopen distinguish committed, uncommitted and indeterminate outcomes without rollback
Verify SSHSIG interoperability against trusted OpenSSH test vectors, with wrong principal/namespace/signature/key and mutated allowed-signers bytes rejected
Preserve half-open expiry, external revocation, exact-head/predecessor and monotonic watermark assertions
Complete new-head Windows native compile/test matrix; rust-ci required success alone does not summarize Bazel success
